Here is an analogy to anchor the next step. Think of a lambda as a small, self-contained errand runner you dispatch from your kitchen. If the ingredient it needs is already in the pantry (a global variable), it can walk in and grab it any time — no preparation needed. - `[ready]` — capture **by value** (the lambda gets its own copy at the moment of creation)
- `[&ready]` — capture **by reference** (the lambda holds a reference to the original variable)
